claim: EU, EEA and Swiss nationals applying to the first year of a licence at a French university must use Parcoursup; non-EU applicants without a French or European baccalaureate use the demande d'admission préalable (DAP) instead.
excerpt: Les candidats ressortissants Suisse ou d'un pays de l'Union européenne ou de l'Espace économique européen doivent se connecter à Parcoursup.
interpretation: So an IB student with EU, EEA or Swiss nationality applies to a public university through the same platform as French school-leavers. A non-EU student uses the DAP (dossier blanc via the embassy, or dossier vert if resident in France), which this site does not record as a route.
